qualification: future measurements only; none executed on AMD during this preparation
native_topology: three isolated processgroups/data directories, each assigned one allowedCPU; all Redis/JVMthreads restricted to roleCPU; total utilization sums3roles to match serialworld ownership
baseline: same pinned Redis/JDK/jars/flags/dataset/warmup/offeredschedule;60s active+actual check/drain; report nofault baseline separately, never substitute proxy fault semantics for VMM partition
fault_comparison: if native link-delay/loss baseline becomes necessary, obtain a scoped approved mechanism and quantify its costs; do not alter host firewall, global routes orservices during preparation

cpu_measurement.primary: inherited perf groups launched around each role before startup; begin measurement only atready using perf control enable/disable; include all existing/futurethreads and Redisfork descendants
cpu_measurement.calibration: sumCPUexecution_ns / conditional_branches per role and overall, recording perf time_enabled/time_running; reject unaccounted multiplexing; retain phase/JIT/kernel mix, not just an aggregate
cpu_measurement.event: W5a qualified raw config/profile required; retained probe candidate config0x5100d1 is not assumed qualified; native excludes guests but counts CPL0+3
cpu_measurement.guard: no perf permission/sysctl/MSR change bybenchmark; report unavailable counters as missing; kernelwork outside trackedprocesses is a measured coverage limitation
cpu_measurement.fallback: read /proc processgroup CPUtime, including children, with lifetime-aware no-double-count accounting; sampling losses/exitedthreads and kernelworker omission stated

wakeup_measurement.native_proxy: delta of per-thread voluntary/involuntarycontextswitches plus optional read-only sched:sched_wakeup tracepoints scoped toownedthreads; report raw counts and sampling/tracepoint coverage
limitations: contextswitch is not a wakeup: preemption and runnable rescheduling count too
oneguest thread wakeup need not wake a haltedvCPU
multipleguest wakeups can coalesce into onemachine episode
nativekernel/irq/disk background differs from pinned guestkernel
tracepoint permissions and overhead must be recorded
wakeup_measurement.deciding_metric: world/VMM counts actual halted->runnable machineepisodes and timer/devicecauses; accrue exclusive attributedhostsegments until nextHLT; report episodeCPUtime and mechanismoverhead separately
wakeup_measurement.overhead: perwake mechanismoverhead requires calibrated guestexecution/entryexit attribution; do not label contextswitch latency or totalepisode wall as hostVMwakeupcost

busy_comparison: per-role active CPU execution versus calibrated countedguestwork at same pinned inputs/phase; report role and total busy slowdown; include kernel/JIT/GC tasks, do not count skippedidle time asCPU work
host_pin: before and after each actual run, match full uname/kernelbuild/CPUmodel/CPUID/microcode and W5a counter/workaround profile; reject changes midround
hardware_handoff: singleAMDbox/common nonblockinglock; W5a first, benchmark breakdown next; extra hardware unnecessary for prep
